Mock request comparisons cover exact URL/method/body, plus both envelope/context fields; injected fetch's explicit header object is not the socket codec and is not claimed as a raw wire equivalence test.

The native transport reuses the established provider connector/proxy configuration, redirect implementation and gzip/deflate/br decoder. Approver authentication still rejects redirects, whereas the portable SOP evaluator follows the existing fetch policy. A known response-head failure is distinct from a body/decode-budget failure, so a potentially committed submit is never labeled a safe transport retry. Invalid JSON preserves TS response.json().catch(()=>undefined) before envelope validation. Native ceiling:8MiB decoded response and an absolute request/body deadline, with default30s when timeoutMs is absent; explicit timeoutMs uses the existing Node timer normalization. Body resource failures are unsafe protocol errors and cancellation also interrupts manifest-lock waits. These are native resource/cancellation differences requiring separate non-frozen ledger registration; no user approval or complete execution claim is implied.

Rust candidate contains30-case/32-outcome replay, manifest waiter cancellation, real loopback gzip/decoded limit/body deadline tests. It has not been compiled or run by its author; root runs Rust exclusively on mbp2. This client does not remove SOP startup gating or replace the required business controller/native executor integration.
